rules.name: recon-snapshot-widen-aftercheck-dev-uat
rules.sql: SELECT c.relname AS view_name, c.relkind::text AS kind, coalesce(c.relacl::text, '') AS acl FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table', 'helper_actual_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table', 'helper_traders_p_and_g_view_cache_table', 'helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view', 'helper_risk_office_otc_report_new', 'helper_eod_monthend_report_view') ORDER BY c.relname

SELECT c.relname AS view_name, c.relkind::text AS kind, coalesce(c.relacl::text, '') AS acl FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table', 'helper_actual_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table', 'helper_traders_p_and_g_view_cache_table', 'helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view', 'helper_risk_office_otc_report_new', 'helper_eod_monthend_report_view') ORDER BY c.relname

WITH RECURSIVE dep(oid, lvl) AS ( SELECT v.oid, 1 FROM pg_depend dp JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid IN (SELECT c.oid FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot', 'recon_traders_snapshot')) AND v.oid <> dp.refobjid UNION SELECT v.oid, dep.lvl + 1 FROM dep JOIN pg_depend dp ON dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid = dep.oid JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE v.oid <> dep.oid ) SELECT c.relname AS view_name, c.relkind::text AS kind, max(dep.lvl) AS lvl FROM dep JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = dep.oid GROUP BY c.relname, c.relkind ORDER BY max(dep.lvl), c.relname

WITH RECURSIVE dep(oid, lvl) AS ( SELECT v.oid, 1 FROM pg_depend dp JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid IN (SELECT c.oid FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot', 'recon_traders_snapshot')) AND v.oid <> dp.refobjid UNION SELECT v.oid, dep.lvl + 1 FROM dep JOIN pg_depend dp ON dp.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND dp.refobjid = dep.oid JOIN pg_rewrite rw ON rw.oid = dp.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid = rw.ev_class WHERE v.oid <> dep.oid ) SELECT c.relname AS view_name, c.relkind::text AS kind, max(dep.lvl) AS lvl FROM dep JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = dep.oid GROUP BY c.relname, c.relkind ORDER BY max(dep.lvl), c.relname

SELECT s.table_name, s.column_name, s.character_maximum_length AS snapshot_len, d.character_maximum_length AS source_len FROM information_schema.columns s JOIN information_schema.columns d ON d.table_schema = 'opera' AND d.table_name = 'deal_ticket_table' AND d.column_name = s.column_name WHERE s.table_schema = 'opera' AND s.table_name IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot', 'recon_traders_snapshot') AND s.data_type = 'character varying' AND s.character_maximum_length < d.character_maximum_length ORDER BY s.table_name, s.column_name

SELECT s.table_name, s.column_name, s.character_maximum_length AS snapshot_len, d.character_maximum_length AS source_len FROM information_schema.columns s JOIN information_schema.columns d ON d.table_schema = 'opera' AND d.table_name = 'deal_ticket_table' AND d.column_name = s.column_name WHERE s.table_schema = 'opera' AND s.table_name IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot', 'recon_traders_snapshot') AND s.data_type = 'character varying' AND s.character_maximum_length < d.character_maximum_length ORDER BY s.table_name, s.column_name

SELECT a.pid, a.usename, a.state, a.wait_event_type, a.wait_event, a.xact_start, now() - a.query_start AS running_for, left(a.query, 120) AS query_start_text FROM pg_stat_activity a WHERE a.datname = current_database() AND a.pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND a.query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_activity%' AND (a.query ILIKE '%tmp_widen%' OR a.query ILIKE '%DO $widen$%' OR a.query ILIKE '%ALTER TABLE%recon_%_snapshot%' OR a.query ILIKE '%DROP VIEW%helper_%') ORDER BY a.query_start

SELECT a.pid, a.usename, a.state, a.wait_event_type, a.wait_event, a.xact_start, now() - a.query_start AS running_for, left(a.query, 120) AS query_start_text FROM pg_stat_activity a WHERE a.datname = current_database() AND a.pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND a.query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_activity%' AND (a.query ILIKE '%tmp_widen%' OR a.query ILIKE '%DO $widen$%' OR a.query ILIKE '%ALTER TABLE%recon_%_snapshot%' OR a.query ILIKE '%DROP VIEW%helper_%') ORDER BY a.query_start

SELECT l.pid, c.relname, l.mode, l.granted, a.state, a.xact_start, left(a.query, 100) AS query_start_text FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = l.relation LEFT JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = l.pid WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot', 'recon_traders_snapshot') AND l.pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND (NOT l.granted OR l.mode = 'AccessExclusiveLock') ORDER BY c.relname, l.pid

SELECT l.pid, c.relname, l.mode, l.granted, a.state, a.xact_start, left(a.query, 100) AS query_start_text FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = l.relation LEFT JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = l.pid WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot', 'recon_traders_snapshot') AND l.pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND (NOT l.granted OR l.mode = 'AccessExclusiveLock') ORDER BY c.relname, l.pid

SELECT t.relname AS table_name, i.relname AS index_name, x.indisvalid, x.indisready FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = x.indrelid JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = x.indexrelid WHERE t.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND t.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot', 'recon_traders_snapshot') AND (NOT x.indisvalid OR NOT x.indisready)

SELECT t.relname AS table_name, i.relname AS index_name, x.indisvalid, x.indisready FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = x.indrelid JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = x.indexrelid WHERE t.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND t.relname IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot', 'recon_traders_snapshot') AND (NOT x.indisvalid OR NOT x.indisready)
